data.conditional_development_period: 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31 only if every calibration gate passes
data.final_venue_boundary: Any survivor requires exact Bybit replay before ranking or 2024 opening.
data.provider: Binance Vision official public archives as an initial proxy

execution.slot_reuse: not before the open following the candle in which a stop or target was touched

explainable_rule.accumulation: At least six completed 5-minute bars with high probability of the learned low-energy state form one frozen dealing range.
explainable_rule.distribution: The next completed bar must enter the learned delivery state and close with a body in the reversal direction.
explainable_rule.entry: Next exact 5-minute open after distribution confirmation.
explainable_rule.exit: Target, structural stop, adverse gap stop, or punitive source-boundary stop charge; never elapsed-time liquidation.
explainable_rule.manipulation: The learned high-range/high-wick state must raid one frozen boundary by at least 0.10 prior ATR and close back inside.
explainable_rule.stop: Beyond the manipulation extreme plus 0.10 prior ATR.
explainable_rule.target: Untouched opposite boundary of the frozen accumulation range.

model.inference: Causal forward filtering only. Full-sequence Viterbi, smoothed posterior state and future labels are prohibited.
model.state_mapping: Lowest range/return/body energy is accumulation; highest range plus wick-minus-body score among remaining states is manipulation; final state is distribution.
model.training: 2021 only; chronological complete 5-minute sequences; KMeans initialization followed by Baum-Welch EM.
model.type: one shared three-state diagonal Gaussian HMM

research_question: Can one shared three-state causal HMM identify accumulation, manipulation and distribution strongly enough that a single PO3 liquidity-raid setup survives realistic 24bp cost and concentration stress?
